metadata.title: Computing Fréchet on Unknown Submanifolds of Riemannian Manifolds
metadata.abstract: Empirical averages are fundamental statistical primitives. On nonlinear spaces, their generalization, the Fréchet mean, generally lacks a closed-form solution, and its computation requires solving an optimization problem. We study the computation of intrinsic Fréchet means for data supported on an unknown compact $d$-dimensional Riemannian manifold $M_{1}$ embedded in an ambient metric space $(X,d_{\operatorname{obs}})$. Such settings arise when observations are better represented in non-Euclidean spaces, like probability distributions in Wasserstein space. We assume access only to a local sampler on $M_{1}$ and the observation metric $d_{\operatorname{obs}}$, without knowledge of its intrinsic geometry. We propose a graph-based iterative algorithm that adaptively samples the manifold and approximates geodesic interpolation. Under mild assumptions, we establish an $O(1/T)$ expected objective gap guarantee using at most $\widetilde{O}(T^{4d+3})$ sampled points. As a byproduct of our analysis we extend the metric equivalence guarantees of ISOMAP from Euclidean to Riemannian ambient spaces, which may be of independent interest. Numerical experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our method for computing intrinsic averages on unknown data manifolds.
metadata.comment: 80 pages (35 pages of main text, approximately 41 pages of appendices, plus references and contents); 18 figures

analysis.workSummary: 仅用未知紧嵌入流形的局部采样器和观测距离，自适应建图逼近测地插值并计算内蕴 Fréchet 均值；在所述假设下获得期望目标差 O(1/T)，采样量至多为 T^(4d+3) 的对数量级修正。
analysis.breakthrough: 同时把 ISOMAP 的度量等价保证扩展至黎曼环境空间。
analysis.limitations: 依据官方摘要和作者评论的摘要级分析，尚未审读完整证明。采样复杂度随内蕴维数快速增长；不能把理论收敛率误读为高维低成本计算保证。 AI 披露另见独立全文核查。
